notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Released
notes.notes:
This release contains some bug fixes and additional quality of life improvements.

[list]
[*] "Fixed" area where player could previously go out of bounds.  
[*] Improved manor exterior environment, visuals, and related ending.
[*] Improved audio loop during ending.
[*] Fixed some UI boundary issues.
[*] Added another keybinding for advancing dialog.
[*] Added new notice screen at game start to clarify how progression is saved.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck Support
notes.notes: While we await approval from Valve, we just wanted to let everyone know that Midnight Manor fully supports the Steam Deck and has been tested on Steam Deck hardware. All controls will work out of the box and can further be customized via Steam.
